method: Historical mechanical coho replay using Manitowoc River at Michigan Avenue, WI USGS 04085427 daily mean discharge, no measured-temperature score; the configured temperature weight is zero because no multi-season daily record passed replay, and each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to Hydraulic-only read for the lower/middle mainstem. Temperature is unavailable and has zero influence; the gauge does not represent the harbor or upper corridor. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
